newsitem.title: TAIWAN: EVA, GE sign engine plant deal.
newsitem.headline: EVA, GE sign engine plant deal.

text.p: EVA Airways, a unit of shipping giant Evergreen Marine, said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement with a unit of U.S. giant General Electric Co to build an airplane generator repair plant in Taiwan.
EVA vice chairman Hsu Jui-yuan and Bill Vareschi, chairman of General Electric Aircraft Engines Corp, signed a letter of intent in Paris on June 15, EVA said in a statement from its Taipei office.
"The cooperation of the two companies... will provide airline companies in Taiwan and other Asia Pacific regions the most advanced engine repair service," EVA said.
EVA, which did not disclose monetary details on the joint venture, said the new plant's first generator testing site was scheduled for completion in October.
It did not say when the rest of the plant would begin operation.
General Electric in May signed a deal with Taiwan's state-owned Aerospace Industrial Development Corp to make components for CT7 helicopter engines as part of an international consortium.
